🤒 Leah is on the mend — the fever broke.
🤒 Kaia is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse.
🤒 Nikos is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse.
— DAY 12 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ghost Pipe — named and noted.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from Emberhold bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Beloved. Strangers ask for your blessing. You don't know what to do with that.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.

refusalLines.line: ◈ CRISIS — THE BREACH. It got INSIDE. The haven was supposed to be the safe place — the one place. It isn’t.
SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. The creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE LIVING WIRE! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
It comes apart — no one in reach, no one chasing. The fight ends; they melt back into the wilds.
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
🐗 This one came with the raid on Haven — it was with the teeth at the door, not a lone wanderer.
(The game is telling you something: this is bigger than one person. Talk to your companions — "We should name this. Us.")
